clean.description: Runs the tool's own clean commands when given, then removes the outputs the named targets of the project declare and the matches of the named patterns, keeping any the workspace tracks as source, and empties the named folders

upgrade.description: Runs a tool's upgrade commands in order, and under a dry run each command's own dry run in its place, printing a command without one

publish.description: Delivers the files a project's packaging targets wrote to its registry or store through its tool's own publish command where the destination's credential is set and the checked-out commit holds the project's tag nx release made from release.releaseTag.pattern, and names the missing variable or tag where it is not; runs through nx release publish, a dry run previewing every project

attach.description: Uploads the files a project's packaging targets wrote to the GitHub release of the project's tag at the checked-out commit through gh release upload --clobber, or where GitHub holds no release of that tag, which gh api graphql reads, creates it with those files through gh release create --verify-tag, the tag nx release made from release.releaseTag.pattern or one made by hand, fails where that read fails, and uploads nothing where HEAD holds no tag of the project, a dry run previewing every project
